interface.signature: def articulationPoints(V: int, adj: List[List[int]]) -> List[int]: ...

preconditions.expression: V >= 1 and isinstance(V, int) and all(isinstance(neighbors, list) for neighbors in adj) and len(adj) == V and all(isinstance(u, int) and isinstance(v, int) for neighbors in adj for u in neighbors for v in neighbors)
preconditions.description: V is a positive integer (1 ≤ V ≤ 10^4), adj is a list of V adjacency lists where each adjacency list contains integers representing connected vertices (undirected graph, may include loops).

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= u < V and 0 <= v < V for neighbors in adj for u in neighbors for v in neighbors)
preconditions.description: All vertices in adj are valid indices in the range [0, V-1].

postconditions.expression: sorted(return_value) == sorted([v for v in range(V) if (len(adj) > 1 and (not any(0 <= u < V and u != v and u in adj[v] for u in range(V)))) or (any(0 <= u < V and u != v and u in adj[v] for u in range(V)) and any(0 <= u < V and u != v and v in adj[u] for u in range(V)) and (len(adj) > 1 or any(len(adj[u]) > 1 for u in range(V))))]) or return_value == [-1]
postconditions.description: The returned list contains all articulation points (vertices whose removal increases the number of connected components) in sorted order. If no such vertices exist, return [-1].

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(v, int) for v in return_value) and (return_value == [-1] or all(0 <= v < V for v in return_value))
postconditions.description: All elements in the returned list are integers within the valid vertex range [0, V-1], or the list is [-1] if no articulation points exist.
